ns2:course.label: Introduction to Theatre Arts
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the arts of theater for non-majors, including acting, design, directing, dramaturgy, and playwriting, together with a survey of theatrical history, minority theater, and plays by women. Attendance at Department of Theater productions (ticket fee required). Credit not given for both THEA 101 and THEA 102.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit not given for both THEA 101 and THEA 102.
